_howto: Bi-weekly Gen 2 CREATURE update lives here (the pets have their own file, gen2-pets-progress.json). Per set: 'done' = stages fully completed (1 Direction, 2 Concepts, 3 Sketches, 4 Final art, 5 In game), 'active' = being worked right now (shows the next stage as in-progress), optional 'status':'next' shows an 'Up next' chip on a queued set. 'note' is shown verbatim on the card; 'focus' is the global 'next two weeks' line; 'updated' is the announcement date (YYYY-MM-DD). The array order is the order the road is drawn in. Optional translations per entry: "i18n": { "pt": { "note": "…" } }.
focus: The creature sets are on hold while the Gen 2 pets get built, the order you voted for. The Yogurt Zombies are the closest to finished and now come last on purpose, so everything the team learns on the other sets can go back into them.

pt.focus: Os sets de criaturas estão em pausa enquanto os pets Gen 2 são produzidos, a ordem que você votou. Os Yogurt Zombies são os mais perto de ficarem prontos e agora vêm por último de propósito, para que tudo o que o time aprender nos outros sets volte para eles.

de.focus: Die Kreaturen-Sets pausieren, während die Gen-2-Pets gebaut werden, die Reihenfolge, für die du gestimmt hast. Die Yogurt Zombies sind am weitesten und kommen jetzt mit Absicht zuletzt, damit alles, was das Team an den anderen Sets lernt, in sie zurückfließen kann.

ru.focus: Наборы существ на паузе, пока делают питомцев Gen 2: за этот порядок проголосовали вы. Yogurt Zombies ближе всех к финалу и теперь идут последними намеренно, чтобы всё, чему команда научится на других наборах, вернулось в них.

tr.focus: Gen 2 pet'leri yapılırken creature setleri beklemede, oyladığın sıra bu. Yogurt Zombies bitmeye en yakın set ve artık bilerek en sona alındı, böylece ekibin diğer setlerde öğrendiği her şey onlara geri dönebiliyor.
